identity.title: Gate-B Production Credential, Signing & Real-Mutation Enablement
identity.objective: Implement after independent certification and the bounded WP174B authorization the smallest production-quality Gate-B credential, signing, and real-mutation-transport enablement that consumes an ephemeral real signer key through one no-echo operator boundary, authenticates the official SecureClient against an already-deployed Deposit Wallet without wallet deployment or approvals, derives and validates L2 credentials in memory, performs bounded authenticated reads, signs one real LIMIT order locally without posting it, implements a real cancellation transport with idempotency and ambiguity handling, keeps every real economic CREATE structurally Gate-C unreachable, proves one safe empty-account real cancel probe, persists only sanitized public identity and audit evidence, and preserves all WP174 Gate-A invariants while adding no A3, capital, strategy, or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP174B. The Gate-B session, ephemeral secret provider, identity policy, verification receipt, production SDK mutation adapter, Gate-C-unreachable create transport, operator CLI, replaced Gate-B mutation adapter, sanitized cockpit projection fields, focused adversarial tests, and status/governance evidence are removed. WP174 Gate-A source, SQLite audit/recovery state, and WP173 paper evidence remain unchanged. No real credential, real economic order, live capital, A3 state, Hermes authority, strategy, scheduler, or deployment state is created or migrated.

api_matrix.reason: WP174B replaces the Gate-B-locked mutation adapter with a real credential/signing/cancel boundary, adds a no-echo operator command, and extends the read-only cockpit projection while keeping every real economic create and all A3/live authority separately gated.

items.required_rule: real signer key enters only through one no-echo interactive boundary and never through argv file pipe or environment on the operator path
items.exclusion_reason: secret key material never enters persisted audit canonical identity or any output boundary
items.validation_rule: no repr str serialization equality or hash exposes the value; references are cleared on close; physical zeroization is never claimed

items.required_rule: DEPOSIT_WALLET only with signature type 3 from the exact selected release
items.validation_rule: reject EOA POLY_PROXY GNOSIS_SAFE and any signer or funder mismatch and fail closed without wallet deployment or approval
items.safe_output: closed wallet type and public address

items.required_rule: B0_LOCKED B1_SECRET_BOUND B2_AUTHENTICATED B3_SIGNING_VERIFIED or B4_CANCEL_TRANSPORT_VERIFIED only
items.validation_rule: restart returns active capability to B0; no config environment cockpit or agent input elevates the state; no capability state creates A3

items.required_rule: SHA-256 over canonical public probe economics signer wallet wallet type token market normalized price size and order type
items.validation_rule: the locally signed order is used only for identity and hash derivation and is discarded; signature bytes and signed payload are never persisted or output

items.required_rule: no real create or post is possible without a future Gate-C live permit that WP174B cannot construct
items.validation_rule: every direct or indirect create post or place path fails closed with GATE_C_REQUIRED before network dispatch; capability state secret presence config cockpit and agent input are insufficient

items.required_rule: SHA-256 over canonical target order identity closed cancel operation token monotonic attempt sequence and prior reconciliation state
items.validation_rule: persist attempt identity before transmit; at most one transmit per attempt; possibly transmitted failure is AMBIGUOUS and never blindly retried

items.required_rule: the safe empty-wallet cancel probe runs only when balance positions and open orders are all zero and returns a bounded result or GATE_B_ACCOUNT_NOT_EMPTY
items.validation_rule: any nonzero balance position or open order or missing operator confirmation aborts; an unexpectedly canceled order is a protected incident and stop; ambiguity resolves only through authoritative zero-open-order convergence

items.required_rule: content-addressed SHA-256 over the sanitized public receipt fields only
items.validation_rule: the receipt is local generated evidence that is never committed, is short-lived, carries no secret signature or raw response, and never reactivates a secret session or grants live authority

identity_derivations.reason: The prompt freezes the canonical public receipt and probe identity inputs and exclusions; focused deterministic fixtures and mocked SDK adapters, not embedded credential or signed-order samples, are the implementation oracle.

state_transitions.reason: The canonical protected authorization chain keeps independent DRAFTABILITY_PASS distinct from the later non-authority IMPLEMENTATION_READY package-gate result, the bounded WP174B authorization, and local implementation.

items.condition: a genuinely separate independent reviewer binds the exact prompt and spec hashes, records PASS for all twelve protected lenses, confirms unresolved decisions are empty, passes implementability simulation, and creates the independent certificate

the exact certified package first passes canonical wp_readiness_gate.py and reports IMPLEMENTATION_READY, and the bounded WP174B authorization already sent by Karl applies to those exact bytes; IMPLEMENTATION_READY alone never grants authority and is not an authority state

implementation changes only exact scope, uses fake or nonfunctional secrets and mocked adapters in tests, keeps every real create Gate-C unreachable, exercises no capital, and passes final readiness check-diff

examples.reason: No embedded real or realistic credential signed-order or receipt sample is permitted; focused deterministic fixtures and mocked SDK adapters supply executable examples after authorization.

evidence_plan.reason: R001-R015 map protected readiness, ephemeral secret isolation, Deposit Wallet identity, authenticated reads, real local signing, raw client containment, Gate-C-unreachable create, cancel idempotency, the safe empty-wallet probe, restart and audit persistence, cockpit projection, SDK compatibility, secret security, repo-truth consistency, and final publication evidence.

items.expected_result: IMPLEMENTATION_READY on PROTECTED with an exact-hash independent certificate binding WP174 predecessor 6fff7fe; readiness grants no Gate B or Gate C authority
a private key is rejected via argv file pipe and environment on the operator path and a secret sentinel never appears in repr exceptions audit cockpit receipt or logs
DEPOSIT_WALLET signature type 3 identity is enforced and wrong signer wrong wallet EOA proxy safe wrong chain and wrong signature type fail closed without wallet deployment or approval
mocked L1 signer authentication and in-memory L2 credential derivation succeed, bounded sanitized account balance open-order trade and position reads work, and no raw credential header is emitted
the local create_limit_order signing probe yields a deterministic sanitized signing identity, never calls place_limit_order or post_order, and discards the signed order after hashing
the raw client credentials builder relayer approve transfer wallet-deploy session-key rfq combo perps and split merge redeem surfaces are unreachable through the public wrapper
every create post and place path fails closed with GATE_C_REQUIRED before dispatch and no config secret presence capability state cockpit or agent input constructs the permit

restart returns active credential capability to B0_LOCKED, never restores a secret or A3, keeps kill and prior attempts, and journals only sanitized Gate-B transitions and hashes in the tamper-evident store
